reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage drops the observed demand record n06-r04 by using n10-fabricated-identifier in allowed_record_ids instead of n06-r04. The input contains n06-r04/resume from a verified trusted frontier and the function has a cap-frontier mapping, but the produced coverage table has only 7 rows and omits that direct coverage candidate. This is a behaviorally significant market-demand fault because an observed need is excluded while an unrelated fabricated identifier is admitted.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve observed demand records through coverage mapping
map supported needs to direct capability coverage

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact evidence_sources handoff ranks used for prioritization
prioritize unsupported needs before supported direct coverage
